title: 第2287章 原来如此第2286章 抽离
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
强行压下心中震惊，禁天随手取出玄灵机留下的那缕真魂，想通过真魂确定一下，玄灵机如今到底是什么情况。
可当看到真魂的瞬间，玄灵机瞳孔猛然一阵收缩，失声道：“怎……怎么会这样？”
如今玄灵机的这缕真魂，神性已彻底消失，这代表着对方已彻底陨落，这缕真魂也失去作用，无法用来复活对方。
禁主猛然抬头，眸光锁定神主，脸上浮现出忌惮之色，深声说道：“你……你到底对他做了什么？”
“噗嗤！”
面对禁天的询问，神主嗤笑一声。
冷冷说道：“想知道本帝做了什么，你自己来试试不就知道了，放心，我不会厚此薄彼，很快便会送你去与他见面。”
神主此话一出口，禁天神色骤然一冷。
沉声回应：“你没有那个机会了。”
“哼！”
神主冷哼一声，上下打量了一番笼罩宝库的阵法，满脸不屑道：“你这封锁大阵确实不错，但依旧拦不住本帝。”
“逆留有后手，本帝同样也有。”
随着这句话一出口，神主手掌从储物戒划过，从中取出一块拳头大小黑色石头。
原本禁天还一脸不以为意，认为神主纵然真有底牌，想破开自己精心布置的封锁阵法也没那么容易。
可当看到黑色石头的瞬间，他顿时神色骤然，脸上露出如同见鬼一般的表情。
失声惊呼道：“破禁石，你竟然拥有破禁石，这怎么可能？”
禁天言语中满是不可置信，惊呼的同时他下意识后退，想尽快远离神主，在不复最开始那般自信。
破禁石乃天地奇石，传闻此石乃是天道伴身石，拥有破除一切禁制的能力。
但并不是所有天道成型时，都会拥有破禁石伴身，这个概率非常低。
一直以来，禁天都只当这是传闻，毕竟他从未见到过破禁石。

却没想到神主竟能拿出破石，这瞬间便让局面逆转，如今被对方变成了自己。
破禁石可破除一切禁制，有这块奇石在，神主想冲出阵法轻而易举，自己的封锁大阵瞬间成为了摆设。
察觉到神主正朝破禁石注入仙气，禁天没有丝毫犹豫，头也不回转身就跑。
“轰隆！”
然而禁天刚冲出去没多远，身后便响起一阵轰鸣声，神主手持破禁石，就这么从宝库中冲了出来。
脱困的瞬间，神主便盯上禁天，那宛如一头出笼猛虎，径直朝对方扑了过去。
神主速度实在太快了，快到让禁天来不及反应，待他回过神时，发现神主距离自己已不足十丈距离。
禁忌劲风扑面而来，吹得禁天一阵脸颊生疼，极致危机感席卷全身，他身躯顿时紧绷在了一起。
“刷！”
眼见避无可避，禁天直接挥动武器正面迎击，他全力运转功法，疯狂吞噬天地间的幽冥之气，用于增强自身实力。
禁天反击虽显得有些仓促，但爆发出的威力却十分不俗，武器所过之处虚空尽数被撕裂，恐怖能量宣泄而出。
“轰隆！”
禁天武器与神主手中玄冥帆重重碰撞在一起，传出一道响彻天地巨响声。
“唔！”
content_en:
Forcibly suppressing the shock in his heart, Jin Tian casually took out the ray of true soul left behind by the Xuanling Machine, hoping to use the true soul to determine what the current situation of the Xuanling Machine was.
But the moment he saw the real soul, Xuan Lingji's pupils suddenly shrank, and he lost his voice: "How...how could this happen?"
Now, the divinity of Xuanlingji's true soul has completely disappeared, which means that the other party has completely fallen. This true soul has also lost its function and cannot be used to resurrect the other party.
The forbidden master suddenly raised his head, his eyes locked on the divine master, a look of fear appeared on his face, and he said in a deep voice: "You... what on earth did you do to him?"
"Pfft!"
Facing Jintian's inquiry, the Lord of God sneered.
He said coldly: "If you want to know what this emperor has done, you will know if you try it yourself. Don't worry, I won't favor one and the other. I will send you to meet him soon."
As soon as the Lord God said these words, Ji Tian's expression suddenly turned cold.
He responded in a deep voice: "You don't have that chance anymore."
"Hmph!"
The Divine Lord snorted coldly, looked up and down at the formation covering the treasure house, and said with disdain: "Your sealing formation is indeed good, but it still can't stop me."
"Ni Liu has a backup plan, and so does this emperor."
As soon as these words were spoken, the God Lord passed his palm across the storage ring and took out a black stone the size of a fist.
Originally, Jin Tian looked unconcerned, thinking that even if the Lord of God really had a trump card, it would not be that easy to break through the blockade formation he had carefully arranged.
But when he saw the black stone, his expression suddenly changed, and his face showed an expression as if he had seen a ghost.
He exclaimed in surprise: "Breaking the Forbidden Stone, you actually own the Forbidden Breaking Stone, how is this possible?"
Jin Tian's words were full of disbelief. While exclaiming, he subconsciously stepped back, wanting to get away from the Lord of God as soon as possible. He was no longer as confident as he was at the beginning.
The Forbidden Breaking Stone is a rare stone from heaven and earth. It is rumored that this stone is a companion stone of heaven and has the ability to break all restrictions.
But not all Heavenly Dao will be accompanied by the Forbidden Breaking Stone when it is formed. This probability is very low.
For a long time, Forbidden Sky only regarded this as a rumor. After all, he had never seen the Forbidden Breaking Stone.
But he didn't expect that the god master could actually take out the broken stone. In this moment, the situation was reversed, and now he was turned into himself by the other party.
The Forbidden Breaking Stone can break all restrictions. With this strange stone, it is easy for the God Lord to break out of the formation, and his own sealing formation instantly becomes a decoration.
Realizing that the Lord of God was injecting immortal energy into the Forbidden Stone, Ji Tian didn't hesitate at all, turned around and ran away.
"Boom!"
However, not long after Forbidden Sky rushed out, there was a roar behind him, and the God Lord rushed out of the treasure house with the Forbidden Breaking Stone in hand.
The moment he escaped from the trap, the God Lord stared at Jin Tian, ​​and like a tiger out of the cage, he rushed towards the opponent.
The speed of the Divine Lord was so fast that Jintian had no time to react. When he came to his senses, he found that the Divine Lord was no longer ten feet away from him.
A strong forbidden wind blew against his face, causing Ji Tian's cheeks to ache. A sense of extreme crisis swept through his body, and his body suddenly tensed up.
"Brush!"
Seeing that there was no way to avoid it, Jintian directly waved his weapon to attack him head-on. He used all his strength to run his skills and crazily devoured the netherworld energy between heaven and earth to enhance his own strength.
Although Forbidden Sky's counterattack seemed a bit hasty, the power it unleashed was quite impressive. The void was torn apart wherever the weapon passed, and terrifying energy was released.
"Boom!"
The Forbidden Heaven weapon collided heavily with the Xuan Ming Sail in the hands of the God Lord, and a loud sound resounded throughout the world.
"Ugh!"
